summary: Full end-to-end testing of Uplaud Growth Engine (backend + frontend) completed. All 7 backend pytest cases passed, and the full UI flow (invalid login -> valid login -> Sources upload -> Analyze -> Growth Signals rendering -> Edit/Save testimonial -> Send-to-Customer composer with demo toast) passed via Playwright.

issues: Missing DialogDescription / aria-describedby on DialogContent (React console warning). Accessibility nit only.

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription to EmailComposer's DialogContent to silence a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: CORS uses allow_credentials=True with allow_origins='*' as default; when CORS_ORIGINS is unset the browser will still refuse credentialed requests. Not blocking (frontend uses Bearer token in header, not cookies), but should be tightened.
server.py analyze_source: no locking / idempotency; concurrent double-clicks will trigger duplicate LLM calls (frontend disables the button which mitigates this).
extract_text: if a .txt file contains only whitespace the upload fails with 400 – acceptable but not visible in UI (only toast).

GrowthSignalsTab: after successful analyze there is no auto tab switch; the review request mentioned analyze on Sources 'switches to Growth Signals tab'. In my test the Signals tab did become active because Dashboard.onAnalyze presumably switches — confirmed working in E2E.
seed_data_creation: Uploaded TEST_brightpath_demo.txt via the Sources UI (also /tmp/brightpath_demo.txt is used as demo). One additional source created during pytest via API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend + Frontend fully validated. LLM analyze endpoint (GPT-5.5) takes ~10-25s. If retesting, delete accumulated test sources from the sources collection to keep the list clean, or clear the demo user's sources.
